definitions.full: H996. bayin [ בַּ֫יִן ] substantive properly interval, space between ( id. ) — construct בֵּין once Isa 44:4 (Baer) בֵּינוֺ בֵינֵךְ, ֵבּינְךָ, בֵּינִי, בֵּן, ( בֵּינָיו Josh 3:4 ; 8:11 Qr); with plural suffix in plural form בֵּינֵינוּ ( בֵּנֵינוּ ), etc.; also בֵּינוֺת Ezek 10:2 (twice in verse); 10:6 (twice in verse); 10:7 (twice in verse) (+ 1:13 ᵐ5 Hi Ew etc. for דְּמוּת ), בֵּינוֺתֵינוּ Gen 26:28 ; Josh 22:34 ; Judg 11:10 , בֵּינוֺתָם Gen 42:23 ; 2Sam 21:7 ; Jer 25:16 ; dual בֵּנַיִם (see below); — 1 always (except dual) as preposition in the interval of , between (so Aramaic בֵּין , & plural בֵּינֵי , , ; ), as Gen 15:17 הַגְּזָרִים בֵּין between the pieces, Exod 13:9 and elsewhere עֵינֶיךָ בֵּין between thy eyes (see עַיִן ), Isa 22:11 and elsewhere between the two walls (see חוֺמָה ), Job 24:11 ; 30:7 ; Job 40:30 part him between merchants; rather more Generally among Hosea 13:15 ; Song 2:2-3 , Ezek 19:2 ; 31:3 ; Job 34:37 ; less exactly within Prov 26:13 a lion is הָֽרְחֹבוֺת בֵּין within the board places (compare 23:13 בְּתוֺךְ ): once with a singular (unusual) Dan 8:16 אוּלַי בֵּין between the Ulai, i.e. between its banks. When the space separating two distinct objects is to be indicated, this is done a. most commonly by repeating בין , as Gen 13:3 הָעָ֑י וּבֵין בֵּיתְאֵל בֵּין literally in the interval of Bethel, and in the interval of `Ai, i.e. between Bethel and `Ai, 16:14 ; 17:7 ; 31:50-51 , +? b. more rarely by לְ ֗֗֗ בֵּין , Gen 1:6 dividing לָמָ֑יִם מַיִם בֵּין literally in the interval of waters with reference to waters, i.e. between the waters and the waters, Lev 20:25 ; 27:33 ; Deut 17:8 (3 t. in verse); 2Sam 19:36 ; 1Kin 3:9 ; Ezek 41:18 ; 42:20 ; 44:23 (twice in verse); Jonah 4:11 ; Mal 3:18 (twice in verse); 2Chr 14:10 . c. by וּלְ ֗֗֗ בֵּין Joel 2:17 . d. by לְבֵין ֗֗֗ בֵּין Isa 59:2 . בֵּין is used not only of actual locality, but also with verbs of dividing (figurative) Gen 1:14 ; Lev 10:10 , and of judging, knowing, teaching, etc., if the idea of distinguishing be involved, as Gen 16:5 ; 2Sam 19:36 לְרָע טוֺב בֵּין הַאֵדַע can I discern between good and evil ? 1Kin 3:9 ; Jonah 4:11 ; Gen 31:49 (watch between ), Judg 11:10 (hear), Josh 22:27 (witness), Isa 2:4 and he shall judge (arbitrate) between the nations, 5:3 ; Lev 27:33 ; Ezek 44:23 ; Mal 3:18 ; 2Chr 14:10 (see RV); and in other metaphoric applications, as of a covenant or sign between two contracting parties, Gen 9:12 , 15 ; Exod 31:13 +; or an oath Gen 26:28 ; 2Sam 21:7 ; enmity or strife Gen 3:15 ; 13:7 ; Deut 25:1 ; Prov 6:19 ; peace 1 Kings 5:26; good-will 14:9 . — It is used of time in the phrase of P הָעַרְבַּיִם בֵּין (see below עֶרֶב ), & Neh 5:18 יָמִים עֲשֶׂרֶת בֵּין during the interval of ten days, i.e. every ten days (unusual).With other prepositions: — a. אֶלבֵּֿין , after a verb implying motion, in between, in among Ezek 31:10 , 14 . So לְ אֶלבֵּֿינוֺת ib. 10:2 . b. בְּבֵן Isa 44:4 in the midst of, amongst ( ᵐ5 Ew Di Che חָצִיר מַיִם כְּבֵין ). c. עַלבֵּֿין nearly as אֶלבֵּֿין Ezek 19:11 d. מִבֵּין from between: Gen 49:10 nor the ruler's staff רַגְלָיו מִבֵּין from between his feet (where, as the king sits in state, he holds it), Exod 25:22 from between the cherubim (so Num 7:89 ), Hosea 2:4 ; Zech 6:1 ; 9:7 ; Deut 28:57 the after-birth רַגְלֶיהָ מִבֵּין הַיּוֺצֵת that cometh forth from between her feet, i.e. from her womb (compare Il. 19. 10 πεσεῖν μετὰ ποσσὶ γυναικός ) Repeated 2Kin 16:14 to specify the two objects from between which a thing is moved. Ezek 47:18 is difficult and uncertain: see Commentaries Less precisely from, the midst of: Num 17:2 הַשְּׂרֵפָה מִבֵּין out of the midst of the burning, Psa 104:12 עֳפָאִים מִבֵּין from amongst the branches they utter their song, Jer 48:45 and a flame סִיחוֺן מִבֵּין from the midst of Sihon (Sihon representing his people: but expression is singular; read perhaps ס ׳מִבֵּית , compare Num 21:28 ס ׳מִקִּרְיַת : || in both passages מֵחֶשְׁבּוֺן ), Ezek 37:21 . e. לְ מִבֵּינוֺת from between Ezek 10:2 , 6 (twice in verse); 10:7 . 2 Dual בֵּנַ֫יִם space between two armies (= Greek μεταίχμιον ), 1Sam 17:4 , 23 הַבֵּנַיִם אִישׁ man of the μεταίχμιον , i.e. champion (of Goliath). בֵּית feminine of בֵּין בַּיִן, (Nö M 194 f. ; Syriac often, PS 470 ) preposition between Ezek 41:9 b (to be joined with 41:10 ; see RVm), unless indeed a mere error for בֵּין (which Ezekiel often uses); also Prov 8:2 accusative To ᵐ5 ( ἀνὰ μέσον ) ᵑ9 ᵑ7 Hi Ew §217 g ; and Job 8:17 according to ᵐ5 Ew Di 1 (Di 2undecided ). בֵּין preposition between (Biblical Hebrew [ בַּ֫יִן ,] בֵּין ; בֵּינֵי בֵּין, ᵑ7, Syriac , ), Dan 7:5 ; with suffix 3plural masculine בֵּינֵיהוֺן 7:7 Kt (Qr 3 plural feminine בֵּינֵיהֵן ).
